description.sl: Glasba in risanje s teto Nives: glasbilo, kitara, violina, klavir, trobenta, flavta in harfa, pevski zbor, pevec in koncert, dirigent, melodija in ritem, risba in akvarel, slikar, umetnik in platno, glina in oblikovati, oder.
description.en: Music and drawing with Zia Nives: the instrument, the guitar, the violin, the piano, the trumpet, the flute and the harp, the choir, the singer and the concert, the conductor, the tune and the rhythm, the drawing and the watercolour, the painter, the artist and the canvas, clay and modelling, the stage.
description.de: Musik und Malen mit Zia Nives: das Instrument, Gitarre, Geige, Klavier, Trompete, Flöte und Harfe, Chor, Sänger und Konzert, der Dirigent, Melodie und Rhythmus, Zeichnung und Aquarell, Maler, Künstler und Leinwand, Ton und formen, die Bühne.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
